title: Grouped coefficient basis expansion
statement: Let $\\ell$ be a nonzero natural number, let $\\gamma$ assign an element of $\\mathbb F_2$ to each pair of indices in $\\mathrm{Fin}(n)\\times\\mathrm{Fin}(\\ell)$, and choose $i\\in\\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. The element of the degree-$\\ell$ binary extension field encoded by the coefficients $\\gamma(i,j)$ is the sum, over $j\\in\\mathrm{Fin}(\\ell)$, of $\\gamma(i,j)$ times the $j$th vector of the chosen coordinate basis.
hypotheses_covered: $\\gamma$ is a function from the $n\\ell$ binary-coordinate positions to $\\mathbb F_2$
